issues.title: Egyptian man who firebombed pro-Israel rally in Colorado pleads guilty to federal hate crimes
issues.title_en: Egyptian man who firebombed pro-Israel rally in Colorado pleads guilty to federal hate crimes
issues.summary: Authorities in Colorado identified 29 victims from the attack, including 14 who were burned or injured while fleeing and 15 who were close enough to be considered targets of attempted murder. The post Egyptian man who firebombed pro-Israel rally in Colorado pleads guilty to federal hate crimes appeared first on World Israel News.
